item.title: Body doubling: what it is, why it helps with ADHD, and how to try it
item.description: Body doubling means doing your work while someone else is present. Why it helps people with ADHD (and without) start and keep studying, whether virtual body doubling works, and how to try it tonight.

item.title: How to focus on studying when your phone keeps pulling you away
item.description: How to focus on studying: why your phone keeps winning, what research says about phones and attention, and simple changes that work, from distance to short study blocks to a study buddy.

item.title: Active recall and spaced repetition: how to actually remember what you study
item.description: What active recall and spaced repetition are, the research behind them, why you should ask the same idea a different way, and a spaced repetition app easier than Anki.

item.title: What is a desk pet? The tiny companions people keep while they study
item.description: A desk pet is a small companion that lives on your desk or screen while you work: a figurine, a tiny robot or a digital pet. Why students keep one, physical vs digital, and how to set one up.

item.title: ADHD study tips that help you start (and keep going)
item.description: Practical ADHD study tips: how to start when you cannot start, how to stay focused once you have, how to remember what you studied, and which tools help. Not medical advice.

item.title: Best apps for focus while studying, sorted by what is stopping you
item.description: Apps for focus, grouped by the real problem: you need company, your phone keeps winning, you want something cute to keep you going, or you cannot remember what you studied. Forest, Focusmate, Finch alternatives and more.

item.title: Chizu vs Finch: which cute companion helps you study?
item.description: Chizu vs Finch compared: Finch is a self-care pet that grows when you look after yourself; Chizu is a digital cat that sits with you while you study, sulks when you pick up your phone and quizzes you. Which fits you?

item.title: Chizu vs Forest: a sulking cat or a dying tree?
item.description: Chizu vs Forest compared: Forest grows a tree that dies if you leave the app; Chizu is a digital cat who sits with you, sulks when you pick up your phone and quizzes you on what you study. Which keeps you off your phone?

item.title: Apps like Finch for studying: cute companions that keep you focused
item.description: Love Finch but want something for studying? Cute companion apps that keep you focused: Focus Friend, Cat on a Chair, Forest, Study Bunny and Chizu, a cat that gets mad when you pick up your phone.

item.title: Pomodoro cat: a focus timer where a cat keeps you company
item.description: A pomodoro cat is a focus timer with a cat that sits with you while you work. How the pomodoro technique works, why a cat companion helps, and how to try one tonight, including a cat that gets mad when you pick up your phone.
